_verified: 2026-10-28 against the docs above; language rule verified by the 2026-10-29 live spike (18 calls, simba-3.5, all 200)
_notes: POST /v1/audio/stream returns raw audio bytes over HTTP chunked transfer; the Accept header picks the container (audio/mpeg | audio/ogg | audio/aac | audio/pcm) and the response Content-Type echoes it.
POST /v1/audio/speech returns JSON with base64 audio_data instead, so the stream endpoint is used: keyedFetch and onFirstByte need a byte body.

model defaults to simba-3.0 (English + de/es/fr/it/pt only); simba-3.5 is the recommended model and speaks 48 languages including Polish; simba-multilingual / simba-english are retired (400 model_retired) from API version 2026-09-21.
language is optional (locale format, e.g. pl-PL); when omitted the voice's own locale decides.

Rule: language is sent only when the request lang resolves in the simba-3.5 table (SPEECHIFY_LANGUAGES: a bare base is a key, a region-qualified lang must be one of its locales; en -> en-GB, pt -> pt-PT, es -> es-ES) and its base differs from the base of the voice's catalog locale; otherwise the key is absent. The body above is geffen_32 (en-US) with lang pl.

Live spike 2026-10-29: geffen_32 (en-US) without language reads Polish with English rules (7.00 s); with pl or pl-PL it speaks Polish with a US accent (5.18 s, identical bytes for both values). Native kajetan sounds right in every cell and its output does not depend on language. SSML <lang xml:lang> is stripped (SSML cell equals the plain cell byte for byte).
